pronunciation: un · ih · NISH · ee · ay · tid
definition: Lacking knowledge or experience of a particular subject or activity.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: So startling would his results appear to the uninitiated that until they learned the processes by which he had arrived at them they might well consider him as a necromancer.
example_sentence: For the uninitiated, cricket rules can be baffling.
